pages.text: Every 30 seconds, each loaded critical chunk rolls one event. The chance grows above 80 %. The event happens in an area. It uses entropy of its chunk. The entropy does not spread to other chunks.

Corruption (radius 3): turns end stone into entropy end stone.$(br)Breach: spawns 1 to 3 Watchers or Entropy Blazes.$(br)Burst (radius 4): a lingering dragon breath cloud.$(br2)Events never change a block with a tile entity, or a block near a player with the tungsten Anchored trait.
